comments.body: 2026-10-24: on main in 5a319525. A join keeps what it appended in the pending fold until it succeeds, so other machines hear it even when the join is refused afterwards; absorb folds group by group and removes the pane's participant only once every group has folded. One window remains: Left appended and Joined refused in the same group drops the agent from it. Store seam: Memory::failing_after.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description: crates/muster-msg/src/service.rs join: absorb has already appended Left/Joined to local groups; if a later ensure_group/add_member/save returns an error, the taken folded.tell is dropped, so replicas hear nothing until the group's next entry. absorb also removes the pane's participant before its appends, so a store error midway leaves a half-folded group with no rollback. Needs a store error to happen; found in review 2026-10-05.
title: A join that fails after folding a pane's place loses the notices for other machines
